scene_description: Two children are walking along a wooden boardwalk path covered in fallen autumn leaves in a forest. The child in the foreground is a girl wearing a blue coat, orange shirt, and yellow rain boots. A smaller child in a yellow jacket is walking ahead on the path. Trees with colorful fall foliage surround them.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and the ground around the children.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the colors on the path and the ground all around the children.
